queries: WITH per_event AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) AS avg_spent, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) AS mean_event_remaining FROM per_event) SELECT p.link_to_event, p.avg_spent, p.avg_remaining, p.avg_remaining - o.mean_event_remaining AS remaining_difference FROM per_event AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY remaining_difference IS NULL, remaining_difference DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH event_averages AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) AS avg_spent, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), differences AS (SELECT link_to_event, avg_spent, avg_remaining, avg_remaining - (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) FROM event_averages) AS remaining_difference FROM event_averages) SELECT link_to_event, avg_spent, avg_remaining, remaining_difference FROM differences ORDER BY CASE WHEN remaining_difference IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, remaining_difference DESC LIMIT 10

WITH per_event AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) AS avg_spent, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), compared AS (SELECT link_to_event, avg_spent, avg_remaining, avg_remaining - AVG(avg_remaining) OVER () AS remaining_difference FROM per_event) SELECT link_to_event, avg_spent, avg_remaining, remaining_difference FROM compared ORDER BY remaining_difference IS NULL, remaining_difference DESC LIMIT 10;

responses.sql: WITH per_event AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) AS avg_spent, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) AS mean_event_remaining FROM per_event) SELECT p.link_to_event, p.avg_spent, p.avg_remaining, p.avg_remaining - o.mean_event_remaining AS remaining_difference FROM per_event AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY remaining_difference IS NULL, remaining_difference DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Budget rows with a NULL link_to_event do not identify an event and are excluded.

WITH per_event AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) AS avg_spent, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), compared AS (SELECT link_to_event, avg_spent, avg_remaining, avg_remaining - AVG(avg_remaining) OVER () AS remaining_difference FROM per_event) SELECT link_to_event, avg_spent, avg_remaining, remaining_difference FROM compared ORDER BY remaining_difference IS NULL, remaining_difference DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: An event is included if it has at least one budget line; a NULL link_to_event is not an event.
